title: Dated share link
summary: Daily results always share /hra/<date>, so a friend who opens the link tomorrow plays the same question as the shared result. Nothing visible changes on the page.
tradeoffs: Friends land on an archive-style page instead of the home page; the archive page's streak rules still apply (a past day does not count towards the series).
